note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent reviewer, over the uncommitted rfc9494_llgr_self_attach_test.go). RFC 9494 Section 4.3: "A BGP speaker that has advertised the Long-Lived Graceful Restart Capability to a neighbor MUST perform the following upon receiving a route from that neighbor with the LLGR_STALE community or upon attaching the LLGR_STALE community itself per Section 4.2: * Treat the route as the least preferred in route selection". The previous verdict was weak only for the second trigger, "upon attaching the LLGR_STALE community itself". It is closed: TestRFC9494SelfAttachedLLGRStaleIsLeastPreferred drives the RIB's own mark-stale then attach-community ffff0006 commands (the pair onLLGREnter dispatches, gr.go) and asserts SelectBestExplain over the gathered candidates is decided at BestStepStale for the fresh LOCAL_PREF 100 route against the retained LOCAL_PREF 200 route whose peer address is also lower, so every ordinary step favours the loser and only the depreference can decide. Go-overlay mutants, observed: deleting `entry.StaleLevel = storage.DepreferenceThreshold` in attachCommunityCommand turns the positive red (decided at a later step, 192.0.2.1 wins), which also shows mark-stale alone stays below the threshold; disabling the StaleLevelFresh guard in the attach sweep turns only the negative red (the route stored fresh after mark-stale is depreferenced and loses). Both tests passed -count=5. The received-route trigger stands as judged before: negotiateWith -> LLGRIngressFilter -> RIB Step 0 and llgr-stale-received-depreferenced.ci over the daemon. Residual, not a weakness of the assertions: onLLGREnter also dispatches mark-stale level 2 after the attach (gr.go), a second producer of the same depreference, so the production sequence stays compliant if either one alone is removed; the self-attach unit pins the attach producer the sentence names, and no unit tagged for this row drives onLLGREnter into the RIB's selection. The two new discrimination records are body-panic reverts and show reachability only; the semantic mutants above are the discriminating evidence.
